title: The Ransomed Shall Return

questions.question: The wilderness and the dry land shall be glad; the desert shall rejoice and blossom like the what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 35:1 (ESV): "rejoice and blossom like the crocus;"

questions.question: It shall blossom abundantly and rejoice with joy and singing. The glory of Lebanon shall be given to it, the majesty of Carmel and what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 35:2 (ESV): "the majesty of Carmel and Sharon."

questions.question: Strengthen the weak hands, and make firm the feeble what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 35:3 (ESV): "and make firm the feeble knees."

questions.question: Say to those who have an anxious heart, "Be strong; fear not! Behold, your what will come with vengeance?"
questions.explanation: Isaiah 35:4 (ESV): "Behold, your God will come with vengeance,"

questions.question: Then the eyes of the blind shall be opened, and the ears of the deaf what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 35:5 (ESV): "and the ears of the deaf unstopped;"

questions.question: Then shall the lame man leap like a deer, and the tongue of the mute sing for what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 35:6 (ESV): "and the tongue of the mute sing for joy."

questions.question: For waters break forth in the wilderness, and streams in the what?
The burning sand shall become a pool, and the thirsty ground springs of what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 35:7 (ESV): "and the thirsty ground springs of water;"

questions.question: And a highway shall be there, and it shall be called the Way of what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 35:8 (ESV): "and it shall be called the Way of Holiness;"

questions.question: The unclean shall not pass over it. It shall belong to those who walk on the way; even if they are fools, they shall not go what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 35:8 (ESV): "even if they are fools, they shall not go astray."

questions.question: No lion shall be there, nor shall any ravenous beast come up on it; they shall not be found there, but the what shall walk there?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 35:9 (ESV): "but the redeemed shall walk there."

questions.question: And the ransomed of the LORD shall return and come to Zion with singing; everlasting joy shall be upon their what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 35:10 (ESV): "everlasting joy shall be upon their heads;"

questions.question: They shall obtain gladness and joy, and sorrow and sighing shall do what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 35:10 (ESV): "and sorrow and sighing shall flee away."

questions.question: In the haunt of jackals, where they lie down, the grass shall become what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 35:7 (ESV): "the grass shall become reeds and rushes."

questions.question: They shall see the glory of the LORD, the majesty of our what?

key_verse_text: And the ransomed of the LORD shall return and come to Zion with singing; everlasting joy shall be upon their heads; they shall obtain gladness and joy, and sorrow and sighing shall flee away.
